scope: Broad product-area sweep across the 12 mandatory targets; search results are scenario sources only and are not used as primary lesson sources.

products.query: FortiGate troubleshooting/technical tips for BGP conditional advertisement and conditional route maps
products.use: BGP multihoming example only; primary mechanics from FortiOS 8.0 admin guide.

products.query: FortiManager troubleshooting tips for recommended IPsec templates and install-preview gaps
FortiAnalyzer troubleshooting/technical tips for supervisor HA, HA preemption, and failover
products.use: Preemption/role-change scenario only; supervisor HA mechanics from 8.0 new-features and deployment guides.

products.query: FortiSwitch technical tips for PoE dynamic guard band, power budget and priority allocation
products.use: No directly matched PoE scenario found in searched Community results; do not substitute unrelated STP or FortiLink upgrade issues.

products.query: FortiAP technical tips for automated location positioning, LoWi, GPS and 802.11mc
products.use: Adjacent 6-GHz channel-detection scenario only; static LoWi and 802.11mc evidence are mentioned but not treated as a direct positioning failure.

products.query: FortiNAC troubleshooting tips for Kerberos, Winbind, AD join, keytab and authentication
products.use: Directory-type boundary: FreeIPA is not an AD domain-join target; LDAP-only integration remains separate.

products.query: FortiNAC-F troubleshooting tips for Allowed Domains and DNS resolution in isolation VLANs
products.use: Isolation DNS proxy and allowlist scenario only.

products.query: FortiAuthenticator technical tips for TACACS+ authorization sessions and session expiry
products.use: 8-hour authorization-session behavior and test-time expiry guidance.

products.query: FortiPAM troubleshooting tips for Web-API password changer and response failures
products.use: Password changer failure scenario only; CSRF/JSON workflow mechanics from FortiPAM 1.9 admin guide.

products.query: FortiSIEM Community troubleshooting for Visual Report Designer and report-template migration
products.use: No directly matched Community scenario found; use official 7.0.0 release notes and 7.5 user guide.

products.use: Cross-product DNS Filter scenario source only; explicitly label FortiGate origin.

products.use: Mode applicability boundary only; primary timer behavior from FortiOS 8.0 admin guide.
